full_prompt_en: A tactile mixed-media paper collage fills a square frame with overlapping scraps of photographs, printed texture, and colored paper. Near the left center, a torn black-and-white photographic fragment shows part of a woman's face, one eye and nose softened by grain, while bright red lips are sharply overprinted near the lower edge. A tall cream paper strip partly covers the other half of the face. On the right, a dense vermilion rectangle occupies a large area, its surface rubbed and scratched so faint circular marks become visible within it. Across the top, dark photographic pieces and a gray crescent-like form make a compressed horizontal band. The bottom edge is busy with black-and-white striped scraps, rough beige paper, and partial mechanical or hand-drawn curves. Every piece has its own age and finish: some edges are straight cut, others torn or abraded; ink is faded in places, and paper fibers show through the colored areas. The arrangement is deliberately discontinuous. The viewer sees suggestive bits of image and pattern but no single continuous scene. Black and charcoal carry much of the weight, balanced by warm cream, a strong red block, and small orange fragments. The central face remains the emotional point of orientation, partly hidden by the pale strip and separated from the red field by a hard vertical boundary. Light is flat and archival, as though the assembled paper surface were photographed on a table. Its visual rhythm comes from opposing vertical strips, horizontal bands, small circular traces, and abrupt shifts in scale and texture. The collage feels personal, cryptic, and handmade, with its meaning residing in the friction between familiar imagery and broken arrangement.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅可触的混合媒介纸拼贴用重叠照片碎片、印刷纹理和彩纸填满方形画幅。左侧中央附近，一片撕开的黑白照片显出女子半张脸，一只眼和鼻因颗粒变柔，鲜红嘴唇则在下缘附近被清楚套印。另一半脸部分被一条高高的奶油色纸带盖住。右边，一大块朱红矩形占据宽广区域，表面被擦磨刮划，使淡淡圆痕在其中显现。顶部，深色照片片和一块灰色新月般形状组成压缩水平带。下缘布满黑白条纹碎纸、粗糙米色纸和不完整机械或手绘曲线。每片材料有自己的年代感和饰面：有些边缘直切，有些撕裂磨蚀；油墨部分褪色，纸纤维从彩色区域透出。布局刻意不连续。观者看见暗示性的图像和图案片段，却没有单一完整场景。黑和炭灰承受大部分重量，由暖奶油、大块强红和小橙片平衡。中央面孔仍是情绪定位点，部分被浅纸带隐藏，并由硬竖界与红色区域分开。光平坦且档案化，像拼好的纸面被放在桌上拍照。视觉节奏来自相反竖条、水平带、细小圆痕和尺度纹理的骤变。拼贴个人化、隐秘而手工，其意义寄于熟悉图像与破碎安排之间的摩擦。
style_prompt_en: Tactile mail-art collage assembles torn photographs, printed pattern, and colored paper into a shallow field of abrupt overlaps. Charcoal black, faded gray, warm cream, and a large vermilion rectangle dominate, with tiny orange accents sharpening the limited palette. Straight-cut strips meet ragged abraded edges; rubbed ink, visible paper fibers, scratches, and partial circular marks keep each layer materially distinct. Some fragments are granular and soft, others sharply graphic or heavily opaque. A partly obscured focal patch sits between a pale vertical strip and a saturated color block, while compressed horizontal bands frame the top and bottom. Lighting is flat and even, leaving the physical seams and texture to create depth. The composition moves by interruptions, not smooth transitions: contrasting scales, hard cutoffs, broken imagery, and repeated stripes form an intimate but cryptic rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 可触的邮寄艺术拼贴把撕开的照片、印刷图案和彩纸组装为骤然叠压的浅色域。炭黑、褪灰、暖奶油和大块朱红矩形主宰，仅有细小橙重点锐化有限调色。直切纸条撞上毛糙磨损边缘；擦开的墨、可见纸纤维、刮痕和局部圆形标记让每层材料各异。有些碎片颗粒柔和，另一些图形锐利或厚重不透。部分遮挡的焦点片位于浅色竖条和饱和色块之间，上下由压缩水平带框住。光平坦均匀，由实体接缝与纹理制造深度。构图依靠打断而非平滑过渡移动：对比尺度、硬截断、破碎图像和重复条纹形成亲密却隐秘的节奏。
theme_en: A fragmented face and red geometric scraps assembled into an intimate mail-art collage
theme_zh: 碎片面孔与红色几何纸屑拼成一幅亲密邮寄艺术拼贴
name: Ray Johnson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
